title: The Glory of the Lord Returns

questions.question: After finishing the temple measurements, where did the man lead Ezekiel?
options: To the gate facing east
To the Most Holy Place
To the valley of dry bones
To the highest mountain peak
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:1 (ESV): "Then he led me to the gate, the gate facing east."

questions.question: What did Ezekiel see coming from the east?
options: The glory of the God of Israel
A great army from Babylon
A swarm of locusts
The prophet Elijah in a chariot
questions.correctAnswer: The glory of the God of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:2 (ESV): "And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east."

questions.question: What two physical descriptions were given of the glory of the God of Israel as it came?
options: The sound of his coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory
A pillar of cloud and a pillar of fire
A still small voice and a rushing wind
Thunderclaps and lightning flashes
questions.correctAnswer: The sound of his coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:2 (ESV): "And the sound of his coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory."

questions.question: Ezekiel says the vision was like what previous vision he had seen?
options: Like the vision he had seen when God came to destroy the city, and like the vision he had seen by the Chebar canal
Like the vision of the valley of dry bones
Like the vision of the boiling pot
Like the vision of the high mountain in Eden
questions.correctAnswer: Like the vision he had seen when God came to destroy the city, and like the vision he had seen by the Chebar canal
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:3 (ESV): "And the vision I saw was just like the vision that I had seen when he came to destroy the city, and just like the vision that I had seen by the Chebar canal."

questions.question: How did Ezekiel react when he saw the vision?
options: He fell on his face
He shouted for joy
He ran to the altar
He hid his face in his cloak
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:3 (ESV): "And I fell on my face."

questions.question: Through which gate did the glory of the Lord enter the temple?
options: The gate facing east
The gate facing west
The gate facing north
The gate facing south
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:4 (ESV): "As the glory of the Lord entered the temple by the gate facing east,"

questions.question: When the Spirit lifted Ezekiel up and brought him into the inner court, what did he see?
options: The glory of the Lord filled the temple
The altar was burning brightly
The priests were lying dead on the floor
The ark of the covenant had disappeared
questions.correctAnswer: The glory of the Lord filled the temple
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:5 (ESV): "the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple."

questions.question: While the man stood beside Ezekiel, God spoke to him out of the temple. What did He say about the place of His throne?
options: "This is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the people of Israel forever."
"This tabernacle is temporary, soon to be replaced."
"I will return here when the exile is ended."
"No human foot shall step here again."
questions.correctAnswer: "This is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the people of Israel forever."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:7 (ESV): "and he said to me, 'Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the people of Israel forever.'"

questions.question: What does God promise the house of Israel shall no more defile?
options: His holy name
The altar of incense
The outer gates
The Sabbaths of the land
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:7 (ESV): "And the house of Israel shall no more defile my holy name, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoring and by the dead bodies of their kings at their high places,"

questions.question: What evil did the kings do previously by placing their threshold by God's threshold?
options: They defiled God's holy name by the abominations they committed, having only a wall between God and them
They stole the holy vessels to furnish their own palaces
They worshipped the sun inside the temple
They bred swine in the outer court
questions.correctAnswer: They defiled God's holy name by the abominations they committed, having only a wall between God and them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:8 (ESV): "by setting their threshold by my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them. They have defiled my holy name by their abominations..."

questions.question: What is Ezekiel commanded to describe to the house of Israel so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities?
options: The temple, that they may measure the pattern
The coming plagues
The history of their fathers' rebellions
The names of the true priests
questions.correctAnswer: The temple, that they may measure the pattern
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:10 (ESV): "As for you, son of man, describe to the temple to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and they shall measure the plan."

questions.question: If they are ashamed of all they have done, what is Ezekiel to make known to them?
options: The design of the temple, its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, and its whole form and rules
Only the date of the Messiah's coming
The words of Moses concerning forgiveness
The secret names of the angels
questions.correctAnswer: The design of the temple, its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, and its whole form and rules
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:11 (ESV): "And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the temple, its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, that is, its whole design; and make known to them as well all its statutes and its whole design and all its laws..."

questions.question: According to verse 12, what is the law of the temple concerning the whole territory on the top of the mountain all around?
options: It shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.
It shall be accessible to all nations
It shall be a place of commerce
It shall belong to the King
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:12 (ESV): "This is the law of the temple: the whole territory on the top of the mountain all around shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple."

questions.question: The second half of chapter 43 describes the measurements and ordinances for what specific object?
options: The altar
The brazen sea
The golden lampstand
The ark of the covenant
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:13-17 describes the measurements of the altar, and 43:18-27 gives the ordinances for consecrating the altar.

questions.question: During the seven days of purifying the altar, to whom shall a bull from the herd be given for a sin offering?
options: The Levitical priests of the family of Zadok
To Aaron's oldest living descendant directly
To the prince of Israel
To any poor Levite without inheritance
questions.correctAnswer: The Levitical priests of the family of Zadok
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 43:19 (ESV): "You shall give to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who draw near to me to minister to me, declares the Lord God, a bull from the herd for a sin offering."

key_verse_text: "And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east. And the sound of his coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory."
